FROM NOISE TO SIGNAL

One calm place
for the whole story.

01 / FIND

Catch the conversation

Track your product name, domain and competitors across sources such as Reddit, Hacker News, Bluesky, GitHub and YouTube. Mentions arrive in one inbox with a link back to the original post.

02 / DECIDE

Spend attention where it counts

Eavesong flags the posts that deserve a personal look. With your chosen AI provider, it can suggest a short reply using the product facts and style you provide. You decide what to say.

03 / LEARN

See the wider pattern

Reports compare your mentions with competitors. Optional Search Console and Analytics connections add search visibility and traffic beside the conversations that brought people in.

A DESK, NOT A DASHBOARD MAZE

The conversation,
with context.

Every mention stays close to its source and thread. Review it, open the original, copy a suggested reply if it helps, then move on. The product never posts on your behalf.

YOUR MACHINE, YOUR RULES

Keep the listening
in your hands.

Eavesong runs as one Go app with a SQLite database. API keys are encrypted before storage. You can use Anthropic, DeepSeek, Gemini, an OpenAI-compatible service, or a local model for drafts. Leave AI off and keep the inbox and reports.

New installs start with a short setup flow. Notifications and weekly reports are optional, so the product stays quiet until you choose what matters.

QUICK START
# Set a password in .env, then:
docker compose up -d

# Open the local app:
http://127.0.0.1:8080

Version 0.2 is available now. The repository has the full setup guide, and the release includes downloads for Linux, macOS and Windows.
